episodesList.title: Ambitious. Prude. Feminist. Slut.
episodesList.summary: Damini's legal defamation cases seem to be piling up. The board of directors, led by Uma Parekh, gives her an ultimatum that she needs to change her strategy or the company will sink in losses. She tells them that she's got it under control. However, all hinges on the final hearing of a crucial court case which is in Anjana's hands. Anjana drops Arya off to school and has an interesting exchange with the other mothers. Sneha accompanies Siddhi to a fortune teller who predicts some wonderful news for Siddhi! Umang has a sweaty encounter with a fellow trainer. Sneha supervises Siddhi's vocal lessons all in a bid to fill up a perfect marriage resume. But not all goes according to Sneha'a liking. Varun drops by to pick Arya up and shares an important development in his life with Anjana. Anjana didn't see it coming. Umang has an accidental run in with a starry client at her gym which leaves her embarrassed. The Board is making Damini's life tough by censoring her stories. All in all, a disaster week for our girls!

episodesList.title: Strong Girls Don't Break.
episodesList.summary: Anjana finally meets Varun's new girlfriend. Siddhi goes on a blind date set up by her mother. A gym client can't seem to keep his hands to himself but Umang gives him a lesson he'll never forget.

episodesList.title: Long Way From Ludhiana.
episodesList.summary: Anjana has her hands full. Siddhi's got cam-girl on her mind but isn't sure if she can take the next step. Samara and Umang take their work-outs to the next level. Akanksha takes charge and Damini loses control.

episodesList.title: Ex Why Zzz
episodesList.summary: Anjana has a surprise visitor who can't seem to stop singing praises for her former husband. Arya has some uncomfortable questions to ask her mother which takes us into Anjana's past and her reasons for getting hitched to Varun. Siddhi clicks on the link Mohit sent her. The link leaves her scandalised! Akanksha is taking charge slowly and steadily at Investigator.com and holds a briefing with the team with Damini present. Things get tense between Damini and her as she continues to fan the fire. Umang has another session with her high profile client and this time, she finds a way to win her client's trust over with a unique technique. Siddhi discusses the online link with her new found bestie, Mohit. Sneha catches Siddhi and Mohit together and jumps to conclusions about their relationship prematurely. The girls hit the bar. Only this time, they have four very charming boys to deal with. Damini shares an after work drink with Jeh and they seem to be drawing closer. Damini's surprise visitor is back and this time, they have company in Kutta. Umang and her client get together for a glass of wine post their work out till things take a surprise turn. Anjana gets called to work in the midst of planning Arya's birthday party by her boss. But when she returns, there's a surprise waiting for her! The birthday party is a huge success with Varun and Kavya present as well. The only one who is not enjoying herself is Anjana. When things come to a head with Varun, Anjana needs to take control of her life and with the help of the girls, decides to move on. In the most unpredictable way!

episodesList.title: Love Her. Hate Her.
episodesList.summary: Siddhi and Sneha's strained relationship comes to a head. Miss VeeVee is excited for her first meet and greet. Umang and Samara take the next big step in their relationship. Damini has a breakdown.

episodesList.title: Fuck This Bar.
episodesList.summary: Flash back to three years ago when Siddhi, Umang, Damini and Anjana meet for the first time. Siddhi is going through a personal crisis because someone close to her has passed away. Damini is just making her mark in the world of journalism after winning a big award and there's the promise of a first round funding for her start-up courtesy Uma Parekh. Umang's first encounter in the big city of Bombay from Ludhiana is for a trainer job in a gym. The interview with the gym manager is clearly a disaster. Anjana returns home after a long day's work to find Varun, for the umpteenth time, having a football game session with his friends without a care in the world for her or the baby. This can only go one way. And that way is down. Jeh is having a bit of a personal crisis too when he decides to say goodbye to Myra, his girlfriend, when he catches her cosying up to another man. Everyone, except Damini, is heading into disaster and is also heading into Truck Bar serendipitously at the same time. In current time, Damini is feverishly investigating her troll story when Uma calls upon her to break some not-so-good news which leaves Damini hurt and fuming. Anjana can't seem to get her mind off her young, new intern and has a bit of an embarrassing run in with him in her office. Umang and her high profile personal training client go undercover for some fun. Siddhi is enjoying her new found passion that no one knows about just yet. Damini consults Anjana on how to deal with the huge blow she has just received from Uma and her board. The four girls reminisce about how they had met in the washroom of Truck Bar three years ago. Including being locked up in the backyard by someone they least expected!

episodesList.title: Gone Girls.
episodesList.summary: Damini gets threatened by an unknown person for her undercover story. The girls take off to Goa to bring in Damini's birthday. Umang pays a surprise visit to someone while the girls wonder where she's disappeared to. The girls have a blast in Goa. They head to the flea market, get drunk and then pass out on the beach only to wake up to the countdown for the Rewind Music Festival. Their very reason for coming to Goa. Through the festival, the girls go their own ways and land up meeting people they least expect to meet. Damini's situation in her own company is getting more and more difficult with Akanksha closing in on her. Things spiral out of control all through the night and the girls wake up the next morning next to people, not knowing what went down the night before.

episodesList.title: Fam-Jam-Wham-Bam
episodesList.summary: Damini wakes up the next morning in Jeh's villa in Goa and catches up with a long lost friend. Umang and the girls tease Siddhi about the night before till Siddhi reveals an unknown secret about Umang to the group. Jeh invites everyone to his parents' 40th wedding anniversary party and decides to call in Damini's birthday at the same time. Arjun can't seem to stay away from Anjana. Damini meets Jeh's family for the first time and they end up embarrassing her. Siddhi confides in Mohit about what happened between Mihir and her the night before and Mohit surprises Siddhi with an unplanned move to help her deal with her anxiety. Umang gets some wonderful advice from three wonderful women. Anjana gives in and things get steamy between her and Arjun. From the time Mihir arrives at the party, Siddhi keeps running from him. Damini is hit with some earth shattering news which makes her breakdown. Jeh helps her through her meltdown. Siddhi has an unknown man threatening to expose her online secrets if she doesn't do what he wants off her. Arjun sneaks up on Anjana having a conversation with Arya and things get tense. The girls discuss turning thirty and their plans going forward. Mihir finally catches up with Siddhi and is pleasantly surprised. Umang secretly meets up with her high profile client in Goa but things don't go her way. Damini find a way of getting back at her board.

episodesList.title: Reality Bites.
episodesList.summary: It's Diwali. A new year and new beginnings. Siddhi and Mihir are taking their new found equation to a new level by secretly meeting up in hotel rooms. Damini and Jeh get passionate and Damini finds enough comfort to take things a notch ahead. Umang has to deal with unexpected visitors and a surprise declaration from Pinky which leaves her confused. Arjun gets serious with Anjana about his feelings for her. Anjana invites Arjun over for dinner with Arya. Jeh wakes Damini up the next morning to big news on Damini's troll story getting some serious traction. Damini gets invited for several prime time interviews. Varun meets Arjun for the first time and things get awkward. Dr Warsi is back and his timing couldn't get worse. Damini gets wind from Karan, Varun and Asha about a massive story that Akanksha is gearing up for. Mihir has a surprise for Siddhi which she just didn't see coming. Fireworks aren't the only thing that will be exploding tonight.

episodesList.title: Dancing on the Edge.
episodesList.summary: Siddhi makes an important decision for Mihir and herself which does not please Sneha at all. Viju compensates by showing his support. The anonymous man issues an ultimatum to Siddhi which leaves her panic stricken. Umang tells her mother that she's ready to marry the boy her mother has chosen. Pinky is shocked at Umang's sudden change of mind. Damini and Akanksha have a run in within the office which ends on a bitter sweet note. Siddhi sends out an SOS to her friends asking them to meet her at Truck Bar the next day. When the four girls get together, instead of helping Siddhi out, they end up having a big argument. Siddhi decides to do things her way without anyone's help. The anonymous man finally reveals his true identity and Siddhi, although in shock, loses all control. The girls go their own way leaving Anjana alone at the bar. Damini invites Jeh to her award ceremony but things don't go the way she had planned it. Kavya calls Anjana in a moment of crisis about Arya and Anjana makes an impulsive decision which could go horribly wrong. Damini tries calling Umang from the award ceremony when she discovers that the story Akanksha has been working on has now gone live. But Umang is busy at a family dinner with a prospective groom. Umang has an outburst in front of everyone. Damini has a change of heart at the award ceremony which leaves the audience in shock. Anjana's impulsive decision lands her in big trouble. And even bigger trouble with Varun and she end up in a war of words while Kavya plays spectator. Umang is left high and dry by her high profile client but she decides to pursue it and give it one last chance. Damini lands up at Truck Bar to meet with Jeh but she's in for a nasty surprise. Siddhi reaches home to find that word has already reached her parents about her secret life. All isn't well. All might not end well.

episodesList.title: Together Forever?
episodesList.summary: A frantic phone call to Umang by Siddhi, who is in Istanbul, no idea as to how and why she is there.The call makes Umang to reach out to Anjana and Damini in a bid to save their friend from a prospective mental breakdown. They rush to Istanbul, to find Siddhi who then relates her adventurous misgivings. The girls are relieved to find her but angry that they almost had a panic attack. Their friendship is rekindling and they seamlessly pick up from where they left each other four months ago. The girls have a fun couple of days in Istanbul, exploring quaint cafés, frolicking on the streets, and being their usual carefree selves while resolving their grudges. Upon their return to Mumbai, will the girls be able to persuade a very reluctant Damini to revisit Truck Bar after her embarrassing episode with Jeh. Let's see if they reclaim their usual favorite spot at Truck and if their favorite bartender is still around for those round of shots.

episodesList.title: Love Is A 4-Letter Word.F@#k Lust Hate Loss Fate
episodesList.summary: Anjana, Damini, Siddhi and Umang are dealing with various heartaches and roadblocks. Damini cannot seem to overcome her writer's block no matter how much she tries to distract herself with mundane jobs and trivial pursuits of procrastination. Arjun is pursuing Anjana and dreaming of a glorious future with her, which is giving her pangs of anxiety. She expresses the same to the girls. Anjana's new senior is blatantly misogynistic and she is suddenly very uncomfortable at work. Siddhi is trying to find herself by dipping her feet in various vocations. She is frustrated that her father refuses to see her as an adult and take her seriously. In a bid to vent out her angst she accidentally finds herself in a verbal duel with a stand up comedian. It is quite liberating and cathartic for her. Umang deals with the heartbreak of seeing Samara breakdown in front of the media. She feels her insides squirm with pain and overcompensates it by being chirpy and extra happy. A friendly advice by Anjana meant for both Umang and her makes think about their strained relationships. Do they find a closure or do they always remain broken?

episodesList.title: Spring Cleaning
episodesList.summary: All the girls have chosen to clean their lives of the clutter and create space for new possibilities. Umang stands strong with Samara and helps her overcome her deep-set anxieties and depression. She learns some new things about Samara in the process and makes her believe that sometimes it's okay to seek help and solace. Anjana's problems with Vinil grow manifold and now he is questioning her caliber on the basis of her gender. Will she choose to stay or will she choose her self-respect over her career? Back home, she also has to make a major decision about her future with Arjun. Will she let go of him despite being in love with him or will she want to explore their relationship further? Damini's procrastination hits a new high but a phone call from a potential publisher makes her believe in herself a little more. Siddhi is offered to try her hand at stand up and though at first she is taken aback she decides to sail this wave and see where it leads her. Viju vents out all his pent up emotions about Siddhi and Sneha tries to show him a different perspective to how society perceives men and women. What does not spark joy anymore is gratefully and gracefully left behind. They all individually decide to stand up for themselves.

episodesList.title: Hell Bent!
episodesList.summary: After a strenuous and difficult journey and numerous months of research, Damini finally manages to complete her book. She has put in all of her heart and soul into the book and now ventures out to find publishers for the same. Siddhi joins Amit on stage and performs her first stand up act. She is nervous but holds her ground. The laughs and hoots from the audience stir up an urge to try this more seriously. Jeh and Damini are now past their initial hesitation and are slowly warming up to each other though Myra still remains as a looming presence. Anjana meets a lawyer, Shashank who is her rival at work but there are definite sparks between them. Anjana should be careful around charming men what with all the other complications in life. Damini is in for a rude shock when all the publishers are giving her a cold shoulder and a colder response. Umang has taken Samara away for a weekend retreat where Samara and Umang's relationship might get cemented further. Siddhi is progressively getting better at her stand up acts. Now it's for us to see if Amit is the catalyst or the companion that she is looking for. Some new stories begin and some old ones are renewed in this episode.

episodesList.title: Love is in the Air
episodesList.summary: Varun barges in on a girl's night at Truck Bar. He is lonely, sad and desperate for company, Anjana cannot figure out his behaviour. The night rolls out with a little dancing, a bleeding nose and Varun ending up at Anjana's house. Anjana and Varun reminisce about the past but do things go beyond that? The other girls are summoned in for a post mortem of the situation. An awkward morning after breakfast with Kavya makes things worse. Siddhi travels into Amit's world which is quite alien to her but she is fascinated with it. She is determined to take things slowly this time. Amit helps her find direction in her stand up performances after a bombed solo performance. A distraught and disappointed Damini ends up going on a night stroll with Jeh who pushes her to fight harder and shows her how tough she is. He comes up with a suggestion but will she walk that path? A certain pleasant turn of events might also churn a new chapter in her love life. Will she be able to choose between Warsi and Jeh? Samara gets invited to an award show, where she is confronted with a barrage of questions. Will she finally come out of the closet or will she keep her relationship with Umang a secret?

episodesList.title: Crossroads
episodesList.summary: Umang and Samara find themselves trending on social media after the award show. '#Umara' is now a celebrated tag. But is Umang's new found popularity making Samara insecure and possessive? Umang invites Samara into her world and takes her to Truck. Will Samara hit it off with the girls or will their worlds still be distant and apart? Jeh and Damini are all kinds of romantic, mushy and quite the quintessential couple about town. It is the perfect relationship but will Damini be able to sustain this or will it sail away? Anjana whoops Shashank's ass in a case of plagiarism that they were fighting from opposite ends. This makes Shashank offer her a position at his firm. Will she accept the offer despite the slippery slope that she is on? Siddhi has found a new command over stand up and ends up delivering a successful solo show. Is she recognizing a pattern in Amit? Will this affect their relationship? Damini has an insipid book launch and is also hit by an unplanned surprise or rather shock. She takes her dilemma to the girls and vents out her fears and apprehensions. Eventually she makes a choice.

episodesList.title: Step into the Light
episodesList.summary: Anjana joins Shashank's firm and finds herself charmed by him. The chemistry is now so tangible that one can feel it in the air. Should she act on it or ignore it is the question that keeps troubling her. Umang struggles to make her way in a world that Samara is an expert in- facing the camera. Samara comes to her rescue and holds her hand through the process. Siddhi musters up the courage to invite her father for one of her shows. Through her stand up act, will Viju finally become her best friend again or will he get more furious when he learns the truth? Siddhi is also incessantly stalking one of her exes. Varun and Anjana have an awkward conversation about the happened the other night. Will Damini be able to stick to her decision and take the reins of her life in her hands or will she succumb to the flow? The girls reassure her that she is not alone. She still struggles with her guilt of wanting to be honest with Jeh. There is a major altercation at a Literature Festival where her book receives flak from the audience. Umang comes back home to a surprise. Will Samara's gesture change Umang's life forever and will Umang want to take this leap?

episodesList.title: Hooking Up And Breaking Up
episodesList.summary: Umang's celebrations and the wedding preparations begin with full fervor. Samara has taken over everything and it is turning out to be a grander extravaganza than what Umang had anticipated. Will Umang be able to voice her opinion? Anjana and Shashank have a roaring chemistry going for them. Does this chemistry lead to a personal space or will Anjana be able to stop herself from falling for Shashank? Amit calls Siddhi his girlfriend while on stage. Is Siddhi ready to be called anyone's girlfriend? Does she want commitment in her life? Will she be honest with Amit when he lands up at home for dinner? Damini tells Warsi that she's pregnant and the baby is his. Will they both find a way to be a part of the baby's life? Weddings are a lot about families. Umang reaches out to her family to tell them about her wedding. Will they let bygones be and embrace her or shut the doors on her again? To lift everyone's spirit, the girls plan a fun and funky bachelorette party at Truck Bar. There is a lot of dancing, multiple orgasms and multiple shots. The episode ends with a somber note.

episodesList.title: Noughts and Crosses
episodesList.summary: Weddings warrant drama. It is inevitable. Umang's wedding is no exception. Umang tries inviting Jeh for Damini's sake but will Jeh forgive Damini and show up? Damini has a collapsible panic attack and Warsi self invites himself for the wedding to take care of her as a doctor. A palatial wedding awaits the girls as they make their way through the majestic gates of a palace hotel in Udaipur. Little do they know that more surprises await them at the wedding? Umang is irritated and exhausted with the social media glare that their wedding has constantly. Was she still hoping that it was a quieter and more intimate affair despite knowing Samara so well? There are clashes between her and Samara. Is it just wedding nerves or are the brides not ready yet? Anjana has to confront Shashank's wife Sushmita who happens to be a guest at the wedding. Is Anjana imagining it or is there is a cold vibe brewing under Sushmita's friendly façade? Siddhi has a surprise visitor at the wedding. She feels Umang has forced this closure upon her. Will she ever be able to get over this? There is Kho Kho, a Sangeet with beautiful and uncoordinated dances and a lot of confusion along with the anticipation of a wedding. The episode ends with Anjana's worst fear coming true. How much more can things get out of control?

episodesList.title: The One
episodesList.summary: The finale episode will evoke all kinds of emotions and take one through an ebb and flow of continuous struggles that these girls who are now rightfully women of strength go through. Anjana feels betrayed by Shashank when she knows that his truth was not the entire truth. The showdown is ugly and Anjana is left feeling guilty. The girls stand by her and help see her a different perspective to the situation. Siddhi applies for a comedy course in New York and realizes that it's time for her to discover herself away from her parents. Damini has an offer to move to Singapore with Warsi. Will she make that move? Umang and Samara's relationship is getting stretched and strained by the minute. Damini's book is banned; Jeh lands up at the wedding ready to accept her and the baby. Will Jeh and Warsi both put up a fight for Damini? Who will win? Damini has a complication in her pregnancy. Right before walking down the aisle, Umang learns of a decision that Samara has made about their future. Does Umang have second thoughts while walking down the aisle or does she go through with it? The wedding is beautiful and it pulls at your heartstrings to see two brides walk down the aisle in all wedding finery. The girls realize that the only constant in their lives are each other. Endings are sometimes devastating.

episodesList.title: Of love, loss and everything in between.
episodesList.summary: Siddhi bids farewell to Viju in the most beautiful way. Six months pass and her words dry up. Damini is trying very to be a serious journalist and find domestic bliss with Jeh. Anjana finds herself in the middle of Arya's Happy Family fantasy and Umang feels the urge to make her family happy again. Will the impromptu trip to Ludhiana help Umang find a place in her father's heart?

episodesList.title: Gulaal.
episodesList.summary: Umang wants to build her own fitness studio. Anjana can't wrap her head around Arya's pre-teen tantrums. Damini is feral and wild, just not with Jeh. Siddhi sees red while trying to be Sneha's armour. A holi party where secrets spill out in nooks and corners, where drunk confessions are made and where an entrepreneur is born. Will the storm calm down when the bhaang wears off the next morning?

episodesList.title: We are fine.
episodesList.summary: The aftermath of a high is not always a low. The girls have learnt to deal with all the lemons that life throws at them. Anjana is calmly dealing with Varun being at her house now. Siddhi is the new boss in town. Damini finds herself being challenged and irked. Umang will need some help being honest with her friend. Will they find the perfect place for the fitness studio of her dreams?

episodesList.title: Sparks fly.
episodesList.summary: UMAMI fitness studio opens to much fanfare and Umang finally has her own place in the city. Anjana is the unwillingly referee between Varun and Kavya. Damini is not giving Jeh the space that he needs despite making space for him at her house. Siddhi finds herself on stage with a former lover turned adversary. Will she take to the mic and unleash her grief or will she continue bottling it up?

episodesList.title: Leap of faith.
episodesList.summary: Samara's fans make Umang's life miserable, but she finds a friend in one of her studio recruits. Siddhi's first show is met with a solitary laugh instead of a roaring applause. Arya loves her parents being under the same roof, flaunts it even. Damini dons the role of a campaign manager with complete zest. Will Jeh understand Damini's priorities? Will Siddhi allow Sneha to make a friend?

episodesList.title: When love is gone.
episodesList.summary: Umang and Meher are in a whirlwind of passion but is Umang being the saviour again? Anjana gets rudely reminded that she can't play happy family with a family that is not hers. Damini loses her grip on Jeh, feels lost and pulls him to her, tighter than before. Will she realise that the threads of their relationship are fraying? Will Umang break her own heart or someone else's?

episodesList.title: Mirror Mirror on the wall.
episodesList.summary: A thunderstorm is brewing, lightning and all. Jeh moves in but maybe Damini doesn’t want him anymore? Varun wants to go back to Kavya but maybe Anjana is not ready to let him leave her home and heart? Siddhi rebelled against growing up but maybe she will have to? Umang feels like she is back to square one, maybe she needs a new path? Will this grand birthday party save them from the storm?

episodesList.title: Birthday Bumps.
episodesList.summary: The sky is different and so is the mood. It’s time to celebrate. Treasure hunts with tiaras, picnics by the lake, some caustic remarks, some hidden secrets spilled out, this is how Siddhi’s 25th birthday is brought in. While there is cake at this birthday, it does not end up leaving a sweet aftertaste. Will the bruised hearts heal each other or will they end up in scabs?

episodesList.title: Games people play.
episodesList.summary: The getaway is coming to an end and peace hasn't been restored yet. Siddhi apologises to Sneha and breaks down in Mihir's arms. Umang needs to wrap her head around all her swirling feelings. Anjana is drawn to the happy family that she can finally have. Damini and Dhananjay make a good team. Will Shashank finally let go of his grudge? Will Jeh break his own heart this time to understand Damini's?

episodesList.title: The good in goodbye.
episodesList.summary: One needs to say goodbye to the broken pieces. Damini watches Jeh move out of her home and life. Siddhi and Sneha grieve together.Umang breaks down and breaks up. Anjana realizes that she does not need Varun to have her own happy family. Umang’s closures, Siddhi’s airport chase, Damini’s cocoon and Anjana letting go. Will their safe space get demolished? Will the New Year bring in new hope?

episodesList.title: The Pact
episodesList.summary: Our season kicks off in Mumbai with Siddhi finally getting hitched. While she feels stuck, the girls help Siddhi realise that someone who has always accepted her as she is, is the 'Right One' for her. Siddhi finally walks down the aisle and amidst the cacophony of the celebrations, the girls find a quiet moment to make a pact with each other.

episodesList.title: Pact Ke Side Effects
episodesList.summary: The girls are finally living their pacts. Damini is channeling her defiance into creativity, Anjana is flirting with the idea of romance again, Umang is exploring new dimensions of love, and Siddhi is facing the realities of adult married life.

episodesList.title: Unappologitically Me
episodesList.summary: The girls weaves through the personal and professional chaos of their lives. Umang's "third date" with Dubori ends badly, but new sparks fly with Shai. Damini's podcast stirs drama and reconnects her with ex Warsi. Anjana's fling with Rohan brings freedom and fun, while Siddhi's comedy success strains her marriage.

episodesList.title: Growing Pains
episodesList.summary: Siddhi's first brand reel turns unexpectedly viral, sparking tension with Mihir and playful chemistry with Ash. Damini juggles podcast chaos, fertility fears, and an unusual bond. Anjana's fling with Rohan heats up, while Umang bonds with investor Shai over shared scars. When Damini discovers Umang's secret link to her ex's girlfriend, emotions flare.

episodesList.title: Better Than Sex
episodesList.summary: This episode balances emotional closure, sexual confidence, and pure comedic chaos. Anjana finds maturity and self-assurance. Siddhi owns her sensuality and begins to connect deeper with Ash. Umang explores identity and belonging. Damini faces unresolved emotions around Jeh. The Bangkok arc kicks off as the season's wild, liberating, and transformative journey for all four women.

episodesList.title: Handle With Care
episodesList.summary: Siddhi's bold stand-up strains her marriage, while Umang reels from her ex Samara's wedding invite and Shai's refusal to be her plus one. Anjana grows closer to Rohan but faces comic chaos at salsa class. Damini lands a big interview through Jeh, and tension brews when she confronts Ash about his crush on Siddhi.

episodesList.title: Lost & Found
episodesList.summary: In Goa, the girls face love and closure. Anjana's surf lessons spark romance, Damini reunites awkwardly with Jeh, and Siddhi breaks down over Mihir. Umang dreads her ex Samara's wedding, leading to tension but also a pact for honesty. At Pride, Umang embraces love and publicly confesses her feelings for Shai. The season ends with the four stronger, freer, and closer than ever.

title: Family Time With Kapil Sharma
summary: Family Time With Kapil Sharma is an Indian Hindi stand-up comedy and game show which premiered on 25 March 2018 for a total of 3 episodes. The show was broadcast on Sony TV. Neha Pendse was the co-host of this show while Kiku Sharda and Chandan Prabhakar appeared at regular intervals to crack jokes and participate in the games that are being played. Family members selected from all over India participate in the show and play games to win prizes. The show was taken off-air (first for the entire month of April 2018, then permanently) because of cancelled filming. Kapil Sharma had said in an interview that the show will resume later after this hiatus, however that never happened.

title: Flames
summary: Flames is a 2018 Indian Hindi-language coming-of-age romantic drama web series produced by The Viral Fever (TVF). It is named after the game of the same name. It is directed by Apoorv Singh Karki and Divyanshu Malhotra, and stars Ritvik Sahore and Tanya Maniktala in lead roles. Set in a tuition center in west Delhi, the story follows the lives of two students. Its first season premiered in 2018, while the second was released on 18 October 2019. The third season was dropped in October 2022. The fourth season was released on 21 December 2023.
reception:
Pragya Jha of ABP News stated "Flames season 3 is the right combination of friendship, passion, and emotions, highlighted by a lot of teenage problems."
A reviewer for The Times of India gave 3 stars and stated "Overall, Flames 3 has its heart in the right place, just like its predecessors. A few scenes stand out, particularly the heartfelt conversations between Rajjo and Ishita, making these five episodes (roughly 30 minutes) a perfect blend of friendship, romance, and emotions."
Ganesh Aaglave of Firstpost stated "On the whole, Flames season 3 will make you emotional, bring back nostalgic memories and leave a huge smile on your face at the end."
Moumita Bhattacharjee of Latestly gave season 3, a rating of 1.5 of 5 and stated "Sometimes a few series don't have enough material to stay as charming as ever. Flames season 3 is unfortunately going on the same path, despite its likeable set of actors."

The regional versions of the show aired on MX Player.

title: Freshers
summary: Freshers is an Indian Marathi television series directed by Aniruddh Shinde and it was aired from 22 August 2016 on Zee Yuva. It was ended on 13 June 2017. This series is based on friendship and lifestyle of first year B. M. M. degree college students admitted in H. K. College in Mumbai.
plot: The story revolves around seven freshmen enrolled in a bachelor's degree in mass media. They all hail from different family backgrounds and also from different parts of Maharashtra. Each one has their own dreams and goals. Initially, critical of their differences, they start enjoying the journey while discovering their true selves. Each day brings about a new set of fun-filled expeditions for them. No matter how bad the situation is they always stand for each other.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Mitali Mayekar as Sayali Bankar: A dynamic and dashing young lady from Nashik. Her father Keshav Bankar, a soldier, was killed in action when she was young. Since moving to Mumbai 2 years before admitting in the college, she works as a saleswoman at a food company. She used to love Nirav but later helped Manava express her love for Nirav. * Amruta Deshmukh as Pari Deshmukh: A funny character from Latur. Her father Prataprao Deshmukh, a politician, is a member of the Maharashtra Svabhiman Party and head of one of the first families in Latur. She attended H.K. College in Mumbai for her ex-boyfriend Vinit who is also admitted in the same college but is left heartbroken when Vinit deceives her. She is always at loggerheads with Sayali and sometimes with Samrat. She helps her friends during financial issues. * Onkar Raut as Dhaval Mithbavkar: A lighthearted orphan who lives with his grandmother at Lalbaug, Mumbai. He is a last minute riser. He is always late to lectures and fakes reasons to his professors. He gets into a relation with Ruchira when her ex-boyfriend cheats on her. He is always loggerheads with Mangya and his goon associates and his boss Rohit. * Siddhart Khirid as Nirav Desai: A smart and kindhearted boy from Pune, belonging to a family of doctors but wishes to be a filmmaker. He is Manava's love interest. He comes up with abstract and innovative ideas for his projects. He faces issues with expenses due to strong opposition of his family to his interest towards his passion. He won special award of Best Director for his contribution in the play staged at Annual Mumbai Inter College Play Competition. * Rashmi Anpat as Manava Raje: Daughter of Ashok Raje, a millionaire businessman. She is a gorgeous and stunning girl, known for concealing her background and simple behaviour, and a fan of Virat Kohli. She is Nirav's girlfriend. She wrote the play which Nirav directed. * Rasika Vengurlekar as Renuka Bhillare: A meek and timid girl who hails from Raigad. She is extremely attached to her father, a widower, who runs a sweet shop. She idolizes Sayali as her mother. She is the foodie among the girls. She considers Samrat as her best friend and foodie partner. She aspires to become a News Reporter. * Shubhankar Tawde as Samrat Patil: A Kabaddi player from Kolhapur. title: Friends: Conditions Apply
summary:
Friends: Conditions Apply is an Indian TV series that first aired on Channel V India on 8 December 2014. The show was produced by actor turned producer Kabir Sadanand under his banner Frog Unlimited.
Written by Siddhartha Vankar, the show went on a seasonal break, but later it was reported that plans of its comeback were on hold.

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text:
Friends: Conditions Apply revolves around Shakti Rai who witnesses her parents' murder at a very young age. The only person left standing by her is Rajneil Purohit, her guardian. Shakti is suffering from an anxiety disorder for which she takes medications. She has a childhood friend named Murli whom she regards as her elder brother.
Years later, Shakti finds her guardian chained in a prison cell. Shakti believes he is innocent and vows to get him released. Shakti and Murli devise a plan to get a few high-profile wealthy kids kidnapped and then pressure the government into trading Rajneil in exchange for the kids. Shakti plans to have her own friends involved in this. Her plan works eventually but she finds herself facing an unexpected turn of events.

title: Firangi Bahu
summary: Firangi Bahu (transl. Foreign daughter-in-law) is a drama TV series on Sahara One. It is a story that revolves around a mother-in-law and her daughter-in-law. Indira Krishna plays the role of the mother-in-law and Dutch actress Sippora Zoutewelle plays the daughter-in-law in the serial.
plot:
This show portrays the story of the Desai family and their firangi bahu, Camili. Featuring key social issues like alcoholism, cultural prejudice, abortion and modern Indian family values; the plot follows the couple from their romantic university days in London to the not-so-ideal reality of a multi-generational household in India, the Desai's. Core changes in Hindustani culture, like the rejection of family-arranged marriages and modern romantic ideas promoting love-matches, serve to highlight the real-life adaptation of cultural views regarding family happiness in a more global India. The tension between traditional and modern family values divides the family as the couple tries and eventually fails to obtain genuine family approval without inuring deep-seated prejudice, personal injury and social conflict.
Corruption and dishonesty poke at deeply emotionalized cultural differences when Camili's younger sister-in-law asks for her help only to twist her own tawdry karma into malicious family slander aimed at the firangi bahu. In a dramatic display of black magic, family cultural pressure and cowardliness, others in the Desai family begin to conspire against Camili when a traditional paternal aunt comes to visit. This mother-in-law and daughter-in-law drama takes a nail-biting turn when the Desai elder aunt plots to break up the marriage.
The elder aunt unjustifiably calls Camili out publicly as a liar, belittles her, accusing her of eating meat, then of having a gambling addiction, and finally of hiding an abortion and conspiring for a divorce. The mounting family tension spells doom for the innocent and unwitting Camili. Fate folds as the malevolent curse strikes and Camili dies in a bus explosion, forcing the whole family to admit their own truths or be haunted by her unrelenting memory. But then details are revealed while the family recovers from the loss of Camili that the Desai elder aunt is eager to re-wed Pranay to the daughter of a family friend, who comes to stay with the Desai family. Just as grief lifts from the house, a new revelation changes everything, when a survivor of the bus bombing slowly begins to remember that she's the firangi bahu, Camili.

title: FnF
summary: FnF, also known as Friends n Family, is a Bangladeshi drama serial which was first aired on 17 January 2010 on channel every Sundays and Mondays at 9:40pm on NTV. and as of 18 July 2010, "FnF" stopped airing. Redoan Rony, the writer of the popular Bengali drama serial House Full, is the director and the writer of FnF. The story of this drama serial revolves around Mr. Patwary and children, all living in the urbanised and developing city of Dhaka, along with their loving family and friends. The cast includes Abul Hayat, Partha Barua, Aupee Karim, Sumaiya Shimu, Anika Kabir Shokh, Mosharraf Karim, Rumel, Ahmed Rubel, MoMo Morshed, Schumonn Patwary, Saju Muntasher, Shahnaz Khushi, Nafa, Faruque Ahmed, Anika Akter Nupur, Fida Aeschylus Pidim, and Tania Ahmed.
plot: Most of the major characters - Mr. Patwary (Abul Hayat), Bobby (Sumaiya Shimu), Chobi (Anika Kabir Shokh), Johir(Mosharraf Karim), Mostak(Ahmed Rubel) etc. get introduced to each other while travelling on a package tour destined for Sylhet. Their intimacy stays even after coming back to Dhaka. They keep running into each other on various occasions and their bonds grow even bigger. Eventually new relations form among them. Also various new characters get involved with their lives from time to time.

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: The episode starts with a little boy named Rohan introducing us to all the characters and their behavior. A passenger named Johir is fighting for a seat which was already occupied by a lady

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Johir mistakenly calls Mr. Patwari an old person and he curses Johir a lot. Rohan gets lost in the tea garden and everyone starts to find him.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Rohan finds his way with the help of his camcorder, he recorded the whole trip which came in help. The bus driver leave Johir and the weird accent guy behind knowing that they he has left them.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: Johir and that weird accent guy go to Jaflong by walking, they thrash the bus driver and his assistant because of leaving them. They all go on a boat ride, creating rivalries along the way

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: They all return to the bus after the boat trip, but the bus' gear box is broken so they spent the rest of the night at the forest. The person who slapped the driver has no place to stay in Dhaka, so Johir invites him to stay with him.

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: Johir is a money-saver, he sells peppermint lozenges for his daily income. Quddus owns a lottery ticket business. Mr. Mustaq is living with Johir like a homeless person, The weird accent guy Akash called to check how they were doing.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: Mustaq takes Johir to a fancy restaurant and feeds him some food, at that moment Johir realizes that he now has a friend. Quddus' ex-fiancee is trying to call him but disconnecting unnecessarily, so she sets up a scam for him.

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: Akash's landlord sometimes uses his house to hide from his wife, he has a duplicate key to every house. Both the sister are talking about their 3rd sister, who is Rohan's mother, is having a distant relationship with her husband.

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: Mr. Patwari has decided to marry both of her daughters to some other guy. Johir and Mustaq find a place to stay and also search for a shop for rent for their business, Akah called ahead and asked them to live with them for the night.

episodesList.title: Episode 10
episodesList.summary: Akash comes to stay with Johir and Mustaq, and realizes that he has disturbed both of them by coming at their house. Chobi's big sister gets a phone call from Johir and Mustaq for some help, but they cut the call.

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Johir has rented an apartment near Mr. Patwari's house, and has decided to go and have a cup of tea at their house. But Akash coming along with him, makes him lose his appetite and mind.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: Aupee and her coworker go to a restaurant to discuss about his girlfriend's problems. Meanwhile, Aupee's husband followed her to the restaurant. With Johir and Mustaq will also stay Akash and the landlord's nephew.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: Johir and Mustaq both have earned a lot of money selling lozenges, but Akash ate some of those lozenges and got very less money. Akash's landlord is very strict, so he snug out all his article but gets caught.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: The landlord's nephew Rocket has come to stay with them. While Johir and Akash are shifting, Rocket insistently broke one of their vase and says that these new bachelor tenants are very rude

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: The landlord's wife is very scared to take new tenants in their building because of the media and news. Johir and Akash have a quarrel in their sleep and they start shouting.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: Johir and all the others are shouting in the middle of the night, making the landlord come downstairs to see what's the problem. A freeloader comes to their house to take food and give complaints which they created.

episodesList.title: Episode 18

title: F.I.R.
summary: F.I.R. is an Indian television sitcom produced by Edit 2 Productions that aired from 31 July 2006 to  23 January 2015 on SAB TV.
plot:
F.I.R. is an acronym for first information report, a document that the Indian police prepares for each case to be investigated.
F.I.R. is centered on a Haryanvi female police officer named Chandramukhi Chautala and her three subordinates, Head Constable Gopinath Gandothra, Constable Mulayam Singh Gulgule, and Constable Billu, who later joined the Chowki. The show depicts their lives as they try to solve every case which comes to their police station Imaan Chowki, Ravanpur.
The show also features romantic storylines between Chandramukhi Chautala and each of the police station's chief inspectors, Hanuman Prasad Pandey, Raj Aaryan and Bajrang Pandey.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Kavita Kaushik as Inspector Chandramukhi Chautala. She is the head of Imaan Police Station. Initially referred to as Sub Inspector, she was promoted to Inspector rank in 2014. Kavita left the show in March 2013 when she signed another show Tota Weds Maina. She returned to the show in July when 20 years leap storyline was cancelled. Kaushik also played the role of Chautala′s lookalike Sheetal in 2010 and Zeenat Bobby in 2012. (2006–2015) *Gopi Bhalla as Head Constable Gopinath Gandotra, he is the head constable who always gets into trouble by Chandramukhi. He is married but flirts with other women including Lappi Luthra. Bhalla also played the role of Gandotra′s lookalike Balu in 2012. (2006–2014) *Shiv Panditt as Senior Head Officer Hanuman Prasad Pandey aka Makkhan Singh. He is the senior head of the police station but later it was revealed that he is actually a con-man in disguise. He is the love interest of Chandramukhi but gets irritated by her flirting. (2006–2008) *Ali Asgar as Senior Head Officer Raj Aaryan. He is the senior head officer before he left his job where Bajrang Pandey had replaced him. (2009–2011) *Aamir Ali as Senior Head Officer Bajrang Pandey. He is the senior head replacing Raj. He is in love with Chandramukhi but can't tell his feelings as his guru have told him not to. (2011–2013, 2014–2015) *Sandeep Anand as Constable Billu. He is the brother in law of commissioner Suraj. Billu is often up to mischief with Gopi which Chandramukhi doesn't like. He has always have wanted to get married which makes him a bit emotional as well. Anand played various characters before he started playing the role of Billu in 2012. (2010–2015) *Chitrashi Rawat as Inspector Jwalamukhi Chautala. Chandramukhi's daughter. She entered after Chandramukhi left her job. However, later it was revealed that it was just Gopi's dream. (2013) *Vipul Roy as Senior Head Officer Bhola Pandit. After the exit of Bajrang Pandey, Bhola came on board as the new senior head officer. He first met Chandramukhi after a misunderstanding as the former thought he was a goon which made him very scared of her. (2013–2014)

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The show took a 20-year leap on 16 March 2013 when Kavita Kaushik, who played the lead role of Chandramukhi Chautala, departed from the show and Chitrashi Rawat was introduced as Jwalamukhi Chautala, Chandramukhi's daughter, who reveals that Chandramukhi married Bajrang Pandey and that they both had died. This 20-year-leap story wasn't much praised so the changes of 20-year leap were reverted on 8 July 2013 and the incidents which occurred in the 20-year leap were converted into constable Gopi's dream and the show then continued along with Chandramukhi Chautala's return.
In 2014, a live audience format was introduced for few episodes where the actors would perform on stage in front of live audience.

articleSections.title: Crossover and spin-off
articleSections.text:
Gopi Bhalla and Kiku Sharda as Gopinath Gandotra and Mulayam Singh Gulgule guest starred in another SAB TV sitcom Chidiya Ghar in 2012.
Gopinath Gandotra was also part of a spin-off show Gopi Gadha Aur Gupshup which aired in 2012.
In March 2022, Kaushik appeared as a guest in Maddam Sir, reprising the role of Chandramukhi Chautala.

episodesList.title: Imaan Chowki

They formulate a plan to climb up the social hierarchy. How will the plan turn up for Gopi and Gulgule? Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

Gandotre and Gulgule get super confused at the man's story and ask himto file a report after 24 hours. Will this man be able to overcome the bureaucracy and file his report? Watch now on Sony LIV.

Our team of efficient police officers is close by and keeping a close eye on all strange objects from strangers. Will our Inspector's love for Kaddu prove to be costly? Watch the entire episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.summary: Our officers at Imaan Chowki are tensed that a recent survey has ranked their Chowki as the most inefficient Chowki in the country. Inspector Bajrang decides to make drastic changes and change the Chowki's reputation. They decide to crack down on all illegal activities. Watch now on Sony LIV.

They had promised their family members that they would be home but the inspector orders them that there are threats according to the commissioner and everyone has to be on high alert. How will Diwali go for our bravehearts? Watch entire episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.summary: Famous Model Tara comes to file a report because Honey is missing. The officers at the Chowki are confused as to who and what is this honey and how is it missing. Our inspector's heart starts to flutter after seeing Tara. Will our officers be successful in finding Honey? Watch now on Sony LIV.

He reminds uncle that his uncle too must have made a mistake in his past, so he must protect him this time. Will patriarchy win or can the man finally file his report against his wife's harassment.

episodesList.summary: Sub-Inspector Chautala and Inspector Hanuman go out and watch a movie together. The movie of their choice seems to be Lage Raho Munna Bhai. The movie makes a huge impact on  Sub Inspector Chautala. She goes around and apologizes to all the criminals she beat up in the past. How long will this nonviolence last?

She claims that she was kidnapped and that she doesn't remember anything after that. Officers take her to a mental Asylum to get an expert opinion on her. Watch the entire episode only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Kuku’s Missing Chicken
episodesList.summary: A man named Kuku comes into the police station to file an FIR. He complains that his chicken has gone missing and insists that Jokila wrote his report. It appears he has a soft part for Jokila. Will the man find his chicken? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

Constable Gulgule takes the photos and gets them printed. Will the police be able to find the terrorist and the missing father? Watch now on Sony LIV.

They fear that their corruption will get busted and Hanuman is worried his truth will be revealed. Watch how the team deals with an honest strict officer like Mukhtar.

Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.summary: Mr.Cheda comes to the police station with a complaint that a ghost has been teasing his wife. The officers in our Chowki don't know how to deal with this unusual situation. They make Makkhan Singh practice on Inspector Chautala but the commissioner walks in on them. Watch this hilarious episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Treasure
episodesList.summary: When everyone in the station is enjoying their non-veg mean a man named Gauri Shankar brings a treasure box in. A man from the Nawab family who is also the owner of a chicken shop arrives a complaint about his missing hen. Chautala gets and idea to find out what is inside the treasure box.

episodesList.title: Printing Error
episodesList.summary: Pehalwan Dharti Pakad Khade Khade comes to Imaan Station with his problem, he keeps getting calls from hundreds of people inquiring about Dillon. All this started because of a printing error. Pehalwan and his uncle are troubled by this and seek help from Chautala.

episodesList.title: Chautala Dreams Of a House
episodesList.summary: W Developer comes to file an FIR on his tenant who is living in his flat for the last five years without paying any money. Chautala and her subordinates find this as a perfect opportunity to skim some money for themselves. Watch this episode to find out who they solve the case and get themselves some extra money.

episodesList.title: Valentine's Day
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the station is excited about Valentine's Day. Chautala asks Pandey out but he refuses. Two men come into the station to complain about their son and daughter respectively being involved in love and ask for help from the police. Will Chautala help the love birds or separate them? Will Chautala be always alone? Find out in this episode of FIR.

episodesList.title: Chandrika Sherawat
episodesList.summary: Chandrika Sherawat, a famous actress visits the Imaan Chowki for her training and Pandey has fallen head over heels for her. Everyone in the station is giving her all the attention and Chautala does not like this. She plans to do something that will reveal the true motives of the actress.

episodesList.title: Gopi Aur Hanuman Ki Anbhan
episodesList.summary: Head constable Gopi and Hanuman have a verbal altercation which leads to Gopi wanting to resign. Meanwhile, a tensed civilian has been making rounds of Iman Chowki to file his report against the corrupt builders, who forgot to put a bathroom in his flat. Watch as the team struggles to solve his problem.

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Stupidity
episodesList.summary: A troubled individual comes to the Chowki with his friend to file a complaint. He says that a drunkard has been troubling his servant and his wife every night. The Police summon the man and the man reveals that he has been doing so to force the complainant out of the house. He offers money in return for Chandramukhi and her officer's favours. Will Hanuman again spoil their plan or will the complainant be forced out his house? Watch entire episode one Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Puncturewala
episodesList.summary: A famous businessman comes with a doubt that the puncturewala infront of his house purposely puts nails around his shop to puncture vehicles. Is he right in his assumptions and doubts? Or is it just insecurity? Watch as the team dives deep into the case. Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Laalchi Hanuman
episodesList.summary: A worried rich business man comes to file a report against his to be son in law, who impregnated his daughter and ran away. This gives an idea to Inspector Hanuman, as he offers to father the child. This comes as a shock to everyone as he was supposed to be a Brahmachari. Will Hanuman now quit his job and become a rich son-in-law? Watch entire episode on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Holi Hai!
episodesList.summary: Its Holi time and everyone is super excited to celebrate it. Chandramukhi wants to celebrate it with Maakhan but he refuses straight away. This upsets Chandramukhi and she along with Gopi and Gulgule, plan something to trick Inspector Hanuman on the day of Holi. What is the plan? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Say No to Dowry
episodesList.summary: A case of Dowry comes up at the Police station. A father and her daughter come up to file their report against the Grooms family.Chandramukhi gets overly involved in the case and is on a mission to get the wife justice. Watch as Chandrmukhi fights a cause on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Imaan Chowki is Sold
episodesList.summary: Golu Bakdi comes inside the police station and tells everyone to empty up the police station but later on, he comes to know that the person who sold him the police station was a thief and he is Hanuman's best friend. Chandramukhi puts both of them in jail. Will Hanuman Prasad and Guru be able to run?

episodesList.title: Missing Son
episodesList.summary: A mother complaints about her missing son Vijay Kumar. Chandramukhi promises that she will get her son. But later on, she comes to know that her son his dead. Will Chandramukhi find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Prasand and The Burning Coal
episodesList.summary: A prisoner has been shifted to Chandramukhi's police station. Chandramukhi tries to impress Hanuman Prasad but she fails to do so, and takes out her anger on that prisoner. A baba comes and tells Hanuman that if he walks on burning coal Chandramukhi will get better. Will Hanuman Prasad walk on the burning coal?

episodesList.title: Married Woman
episodesList.summary: An astrologer tells Chandramukhi that she has the yog of getting married to the one she loves but she has to keep him away from the married woman. Meanwhile, a married woman calls at Imaan Chowki to file an FIR.  What will Chandramukhi do?

episodesList.title: Friendhsip Day
episodesList.summary: Gulgule has plans for friendhsip day and has some idea where he tells Chandramukhi to buy a ring and put it on Hanuman Prasads finger and this is how she will get married . Will Gulgule's plan work?

episodesList.title: An English Woman
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at the Imaan Chowki with his wife and daughter in law to lodge a complaint against his son whose planning to leave his daughter in law and marry an english woman. Will the officers at Imaan Chowki help him or add to his misery?

episodesList.title: Gulgule's Plan
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge an F.I.R that he was kidnapped and was forced to spend the night with a girl, listening to this Gulgule has a plan for Chandramukhi regarding how she can marry Hanuman Prasad. What is Gulgule's Plan?

episodesList.title: Late Night English Movies
episodesList.summary: A man lodges a complaint at Imaan Chowki against the cable man regarding the english movies that are played on TV late at night. But Hanuman Prasad Pandey is in favour of the cable man. How will Chandramukhi be able to sue the cable man?

episodesList.title: The Serial Killer
episodesList.summary: A man lodges a complaint against a shopkeeper for selling him shoes of different sizes. Officers at Imaan Chowki are tensed to know that a serial killer is on the loose and has killed a police personnel. Will they be able to find that serial killer? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Hamuman Prasad's Due
episodesList.summary: A man lodges a complaint at Imaan Chowki against Hanuman Prasad Pandey that his dad's debt of Rupees One Lakh is due and he has to clear his dad's debt. How will Hanuman Prasad Pandey clear the dues? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: No More F.i.r
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge a complaint that he has seen a murder but Chandramukhi insists that she will not write the F.I.R because if there is one more F.I.R written in Imaan Chowki the Chowki will be closed. Will Chandramukhi solve the case?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Weds Hanuman?
episodesList.summary: A Jyotish arrives at Imaan Chowki and tells Hanuman Prasad that if he marries Chandramukhi he will become rich and prosperous, the same Jyotish also informs Chandramukhi about her future. What is the prediction done by the Jyotish?

episodesList.title: Hero Hanuman Prasad Pandey
episodesList.summary: A producer comes to lodge a complaint about an actor in his film and promises Hanuman Prasad to cast him as the hero, Chandramukhi tries her best to convince the producer not to cast Hanuman in his film. Watch the episode to witness what happens next.

episodesList.title: The Pinch
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against the person who has pinched his wife in the Mela. Chandramukhi Chautala and team start investigating. Watch the episode to witness the case unfold.

episodesList.title: Lovers and The Postman
episodesList.summary: A boy and a girl who love each other, write letters to each other but the postman also loves the girl and never delivers the letters, they both get separated and the postman starts to get romantic with the girl. The boy comes to the station to lodge a complaint against the postman.

episodesList.title: Fraud Builder
episodesList.summary: Akhtar Armaan a shayar comes to file an F.I.R against a builder who sold him a flat located on the 20th floor but the building has a lift only till the 6th floor, because of this his wife leaves him. Watch the episode to know how Chandramukhi deals with this case.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Oath
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge a complaint against his oppressive wife and he encourages Gulgule to stop Chandramukhi from slapping him. Chandramukhi takes an oath that she will never slap Gulgule. Will Gulgule be able sustain without Chandramukhi slapping him?

episodesList.title: Hanuman Insults Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: Its Diwali time, Chandramukhi plans to get Hanuman Prasad to lit the joint rocket so that they will be united in the future. Hanuman Prasad comes to know about the plan and insults Chandramukhi. How will Chandramukhi deal with this insult?

episodesList.title: Exploitations Of a Boss
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against his boss who is a woman, that she exploits her powers as a boss and tries to seduce him in the office. How will Chandramukhi deal with this unusual case? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Fraud Employee
episodesList.summary: A business man lodges a complaint against his employee that instead of delivering the money at its destination he has bought properties for a girl. The business man suggests an idea to Hanuman Prasad to get his property back. Watch the episode to know what is the business man's idea?

episodesList.title: Training The Pickpocket
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki with the complaint of a pickpocket who tries to steal his wallet, Chandramukhi decides to get the pickpocket trained by Hanuman Prasad with an ulterior motive. What is Chandramukhi's motive?

episodesList.title: Lucky Customer
episodesList.summary: Two auto rickshaw drivers arrive at Imaan Chowki with a customer and they are fighting with each other for the customer as he is lucky. How will Chandramukhi solve this dispute? Tune in to join the laughter ride!

episodesList.title: Chopra Ka Jhopda
episodesList.summary: A man named Chopra comes to the police station to file a complaint against the builder who wants to forcefully build a shopping mall on his land. Watch the episode to know how Chandramukhi and team solve this case.

episodesList.title: Faulty Shampoo
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to file an F.I.R against the owner of a shampoo manufacturer, as the man has lost all his hair due to the usage of the shampoo manufactured by his company. Watch the episode to laugh your hearts out!

episodesList.title: The Garbage Girl
episodesList.summary: A man arrives at the Imaan Chowki to file a complaint against a woman who throws garbage on him everyday while he's leaving for work, due to this he is about to loose his job since his boss requires him to wear spick and span clothes.

episodesList.title: 3 Days and No Night
episodesList.summary: A person comes to lodge an F.I.R against Raju Travels as he had booked a trip and Raju travels had booked the hotel only for 3 days and not the night due to which he had to sleep on the road with his wife. Chandramukhi and Hunuman Prasad are solving the case in their own unusual way.

episodesList.title: The Lost Girl
episodesList.summary: An actor named Karan comes to the police station to lodge an F.I.R as his girlfriend named Kavita is lost while they were roaming around in Ravanpur. Will they make a mockery of the case as usual?

episodesList.title: Get Married Chandramukhi!
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi's father comes to the police station to convince her to get married and he starts getting men to the police station for her to choose. Her father keeps on blackmailing to convince her. How will Chandramukhi get out of this situation?

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Wants to be Famous
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi comes to Hanuman Prasad with a Mangal Sutra, but Hanuman rejects her saying he will marry someone who is famous. Chandramukhi decides that she will become famous anyhow. Tune in to witness Chandramukhi's road to fame.

episodesList.title: Naagin Chandramukhi
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi comes to know that Hanuman Prasad is afraid of snakes, Chandramukhi tries to scare hanuman by dressing in a naagin dress with the motive to convince him to marry her. Will Hanuman Prasad give in?

episodesList.title: Landlord and The Tenant
episodesList.summary: A landlord wants to lodge a complaint against his tenant about him not paying the rent on time and the landlord gets a shock everytime he rings the bell of the tenant's apartment. Watch the episode to witness all the confusion and laughter!

episodesList.title: Pehelwaan Billu Bilori
episodesList.summary: A wrestler storms the police station and threatens Hanuman Prasad to kill him because he eve teased his girlfriend, Chandramukhi plans to get Hanuman Prasad attacked by the wrestler with an ulterior motive. What is Chandramukhi's motive? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Akade Pakde
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to file a complaint against a man who instead of dropping him to his wedding destination kept on driving for 4-5 days due to which he missed his wedding. How will Chandramukhi and team solve this baffling case?

episodesList.title: Prabhhu Ki Leela
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against a man named Prabhu who wants to kill him since the man doesn't want Prabhu to marry his daughter. Watch the episode to witness the case unfold in detail

episodesList.title: Hakdaar
episodesList.summary: Two couples file an F.I.R that one of their relative had died a few years ago and his property will go to his son when he gets married, the two couples bring two different men each claiming that the man they have brought is the one whose entitled to the property.

episodesList.title: Golden Class Tickets
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the police station to file a complaint that he bought expensive movie tickets expecting privacy but the person who sold them the tickets showed him the movie on a DVD player. Watch this hilarious episode now!

episodesList.title: Chaatwaala
episodesList.summary: A lady comes to the police station to file a complaint against a Chaatwala and a Doctor, whoever eats Chaat from the Chaatwaala has to immediately go to the doctor on account of stomach ache. What would be Chandramukhi and team's course of action now?

episodesList.title: Tendua
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R against a builder who has given him a flat in a forest area, where the buyer is facing problems because of the intruding animals, even a Leopard. Chandramukhi Chautala sends Hanuman Prasad to catch the Leopard.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Chautala Ka Darr
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi informs Hanuman Prasad through Gulgule that she shot an inspector in the past for spitting paan on her shoes, the next day Hanuman by mistakely spits Paan on Chandramukhi's shoes. Watch the episode to know what happens next.

episodesList.title: Lambi Race Ka Ghoda
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R against a horse owner that he sent the horse used in Race Courses at his marriage, as a result the horse ran away as soon as he sat on it on the day of his marriage. Watch the episode to witness the team solve this hilarious case.

episodesList.title: Kiss In The Tunnel
episodesList.summary: A man with his wife comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against two suspected men, one of them has kissed his wife while they were on a train journey. With the excuse to solve the case Chandramukhi plans to kiss Hanuman Prasad. Will she succeed in her intentions?

episodesList.title: Role Play
episodesList.summary: A struggling actor arrives at the police station to lodge a complaint, Chandramukhi gets an idea to make the actor play her husband to make Hanuman Prasad jealous. Will she succeed or will she be caught in the act?

episodesList.title: Jimmy Jabaaz
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi arrests a famous killer Jimmy and tells him to stay away from Hanuman Prasad. Jimmy breaks free from the police station and challenges Chandramukhi that he will kill Hanuman Prasad in the next 24 hours. Will Chandramukhi be able to save Hanuman Prasad?

episodesList.title: Dil Nahi Lagta
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R. against an agent who promised to send him to Dubai for a better job but that agent cheats and sends him to Madh Island. The agent lures Hanuman Prasad by promising him that he will send him to Dubai if he lets him go. Will Chandramukhi be able to stop Hanuman Prasad?

episodesList.title: Pyara Haanthi
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R against one of the pet company's owner that he has sent him an Elephant instead of a little pet he applied for. Company's owner defends himself by saying that the man had applied for a 'Pyara' pet so he sent him an Elephant named "Pyara". Watch the episode to witness all the confusion and fun!

episodesList.title: Murkh Baalak
episodesList.summary: A school teacher arrives at the police station to lodge a complaint against his student who harasses him by asking stupid questions. How will Chandramukhi and team deal with this case? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Sautan Ki Saheli
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad arrives at the Imaan Chowki after an absence of two days, on asking he doesn't answer clearly and says he's been in the mountains. Chandramukhi gets an idea to harass Hanuman Prasad. What is this idea?

episodesList.title: Budhapa
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad reveals that he is 65 years old. A Saint had given him some medicines to look younger, but now as that Saint has died and all his medicines are over, Hanuman Prasad starts ageing. How will Chandramukhi deal with this?

episodesList.title: Manchali
episodesList.summary: A man comes to file an F.I.R for his missing wife. Chandramukhi plans to go out on a hilll station with Hanuman Prasad but he's reluctant. Will Chandramukhi be able to convince hanuman Prasad? Will the man find his wife?

episodesList.title: Khandaani Chappal
episodesList.summary: While travelling in the train a man looses one from the pair of his khaandani chappals and on the advice of the co passenger he threw his socond chappal as well but later he found that the first chappal is in the train itself, he wants to lodge a complaint against the co passenger for making him loose his Khandaani chappal.

episodesList.title: Kaamwaali Baai
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad hires a woman for domestic help and develops romantic relations with her, this makes Chandramukhi jealous and she decides to enact a role play where she hires a domestic helper to make Hanuman Prasad jealous.

episodesList.title: Ugly Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad tells Chandramukhi that he is very handsome and she is nothing in comparison to him. Chandramukhi sends some girls to tell Hanuman Prasad how ugly he is, he gets very upset and decides to commit suicide. How will Chandramukhi save his life?

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Neeraj
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj comes to file an F.I.R that he's been working at Trivedi's house since he was a child because he loves Trivedi's daughter Utawli. But now Trivedi has fixed her marriage with someone else. Will Chandramukhi be able to get justice for Dheeraj?

episodesList.title: Lihaaz
episodesList.summary: Madan comes to file an F.I.R. against a man Lalit that whenever he goes out with his wife Katili, Lalit is already present there and greets his wife, one day Lalit takes 2 Lakh rupees from Madan and escapes. Watch the episode to witness the case in detail.

episodesList.title: Simple Dimple
episodesList.summary: A man named Seedhe comes to file an F.I.R. against his wife's friend Dimple that his wife Simple is  playing cards and gambling all the time with Dimple and she doesn't care about him. Chandramukhi thinks of a unique strategy to deal with the case.

episodesList.title: A Night Well Spent
episodesList.summary: Ishwar comes to file an F.I.R. with his daughter Reena against Appu Utawla that Appu had spent a night with Reena in a locked lift, so now Appu has to marry Reena. Appu defends himself saying that he didn't do anything wrong that night and he's already engaged. How will Chandramukhi solve this case?

episodesList.title: Faraar Furtili
episodesList.summary: A man Sandeep comes to file a complaint that he is married to a girl named Furtili whose a sports lover. She ran away a few days back and hasn't returned yet. Will the efficient officers at Imaan Chowki help Sandeep get his wife back?

episodesList.title: Kutta
episodesList.summary: Three neighbours come to file an F.I.R. against their 4th floor neighbour Kaushal that he's brought a dog and they are really scared of the dog since he bites them and steals milk and newspaper from their house. Watch the episode to witness Chandramukhi solve the case.

episodesList.title: Raaju Rangeela
episodesList.summary: Raju comes to file an F.I.R against his father's friend Tappu that he forces him to wear colourful clothes, Tappu comes to the station and informs that it was Raju's fathers's last wish to see Raju wear colourful clothes. How will Raju get justice now?

episodesList.title: Khandaani Mooch
episodesList.summary: Mitthu comes to file an F.I.R against Guddu that he has cut half of his Khandaani Mooch because of that he couldn't go to fix his marriage date, Guddu tells Chandramukhi that it was by accident. How will Mitthu get back his Khandaani Mooch?

episodesList.title: Bechara Dulha
episodesList.summary: A man Kapil comes to file an F.I.R against a Bus Driver and a Conductor as he was planning to go to fix his marriage but the Driver isn't starting the journey and he can't go by a private vehicle since his uncle fights with him everytime he books a private vehicle. Watch the episode to laugh your hearts out!

episodesList.title: Pyareji
episodesList.summary: A watchman of a society comes to file an F.I.R against Pyareji Gulati and Pyareji Gahlot that they got a love letter from a girl addressed to the name Pyareji. So now both the Pyarejis are fighting in the society over who the letter belongs to. Which Pyareji does the letter actually belong? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Coolie
episodesList.summary: A Coolie comes to file an F.I.R. against Gappu that Gappu is not paying him after he has helped him with the luggage, Gappu tells that everytime the Coolie keeps his luggage in the wrong train. Watch the team of efficient officers at Imaan Chowki solve this case.

episodesList.title: Apsara
episodesList.summary: A woman, Apsara comes to lodge a complaint against her husband Madan as he doesn't give her any attention and he is having an extra marital affair, Madan tells that he was deceived into marrying her. What happens next? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Tasalli
episodesList.summary: A landlord comes to file an F.I.R that he had rented his house to a married couple and the wife has stolen valuables from the house and ran away, the husband tells that they weren't married and were just pretenting to be married to get the apartment. How will Chandramukhi find the woman whose stolen the valuables?

episodesList.title: Gulgule Ka Promotion
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad makes Gulgule dance in front of a lady, he feels insulted and is about to resign. Chandramukhi feels jealous seeing Hanuman flirt with the lady so she makes a plan to stop Gulgule from resigning and teach Hanuman a lesson in one go. What is this plan?

episodesList.title: Barsaat
episodesList.summary: Hanuman Prasad refuses Chandramukhi to dance outside in the rain with her because he is scared of rain. But on a rainy night she finds Hanuman Prasad enjoying with another girl. What will she do now? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Ajnabee Dost
episodesList.summary: Rimpi Singh wants to marry a woman but her condition is to make her brother happy, so Rimpi cooks food for his to be brother in law but two men claiming to be his friends eat the food everyday but Rimpi says these men are strangers to him and because of them he's unable to marry the woman he loves.

episodesList.title: Rakhi
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi asks Hanuman Prasad about their relationship but he gives a confusing answer, Gulgule gives an idea that she should tie rakhi to Hanuman Prasad to make him confess his true feelings. Will the plan work or make things worse for Chandramukhi?

episodesList.title: Old Couple
episodesList.summary: Gulgule gets an old couple to the police station because they spent the night on a bench, the man Sweety Singh tells them that they thad to spend the night outside because their son Tommy threw them out of their house. Tommy is called for an inquiry. Watch the episode to witness the case in detail.

episodesList.title: Jolly and Polly
episodesList.summary: Jolly to impress his wife Polly took her to a posh hotel, but the sealing of the room they had booked leaked all night, due to this he felt humiliated in front of his wife and now he wants the manager of the hotel to compensate them. Will he get his compensation?

episodesList.title: Kaala Rang
episodesList.summary: Sundar comes to file an F.I.R. against Babloo that last year on Holi Babloo had coloured his face black and because of that Sundar is unable to fix his marriage with Tinni as her father wants her to marry someone with a fair complexion. Watch the episode to witness our beloved officers solve this problem.

episodesList.title: Baal Ki Khaal
episodesList.summary: Keshav wants to file an F.I.R against one of the famous hotels and their staff because he found strands of hair in his food and on complaining he was forced to pay the entire bill. Will Keshav get his justice? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Umraao Jaan
episodesList.summary: Munni and Umraao Jaan come to file an F.I.R. against an unknown thief who stole Umraao's valuable necklace gifted by Rai Bahadur in one of the gatherings. Chandramukhi calls all the people who were present at that gathering to investigate the case. Will Chandramukhi catch the thief?

episodesList.title: Yaadaasht
episodesList.summary: Illu electrician comes to seek help from Chandramukhi because his girlfriend accidently got an electric shock from him and in that accident she lost her memory. Now Chandramukhi plans to give an electric shock to Hanuman Prasad until he loses his memory. Why is she doing this? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Vichitra Ka Charitra
