He goes to insurance company where he had insured the show. He meets with a Mr. Golmal who is boss of Golmal insurances. He is shown to be Billu. Billu passes his insurance money. Gulati tries to flee with the money and is caught red handed by Chandramukhi  and her team!

episodesList.title: Pari Hoon Main
episodesList.summary: Tina comes to the Chowki and tells Chandramukhi  that her fiance had turned into Yamraj when she went to meet him in Lovers  Garden late last night. Someone pinches Gopi while he was going home. Chandramukhi  and Bajrang are taking a stroll in Lovers Garden after a movie when they meet Tina. Chandramukhi  sees Tina boyfriend dressed as Yamraj. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Departmental Exam For Sir
episodesList.summary: Bajrang keeps on taking Chandramukhi  to dates. Commissioner informs her that Bajrang's promotional exams are coming up and he is not concentrating on his studies. Chandramukhi  decides to make him believe that she not human but an angel. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Munni Manchali
episodesList.summary: Munni Manchali and her movie director come to the Chowki with film's hero Gehu Yadav. Munni complains that Gehu keeps on flirting with her on the set of their film. Chandramukhi  warns the hero and then takes Bajrang to the set of the film, Paradise, to try to convince him that she is actually an angel and they cannot date. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Billu Backbites About Inspector Pandey
episodesList.summary: Bajrang tells Chandramukhi  that he wants to visit moon. So, with the help of the Director, Chandramukhi  takes him to a set that looks like the moon. But soon, the Commissioner tells Chandramukhi  that Bajrang has passed his exams. Chandramukhi  reveals to Bajrang that it was all drama. Will he aChandramukhi ept her?

episodesList.title: Mohalle Ki Premika
episodesList.summary: Mahulla and his wife complain to Chandramukhi  that Mahula was robbed when he was watching an 8D film in Narayan Theatre. He claims the movie's heroine came out of the curtain and robbed him. Bajrang decides to take Chandramukhi  in same theatre to watch same movie. What will happen next? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: 3 Ghante Se Madam Laapatha
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi  goes to see the movie and in front of her the heroine comes out and robs a necklace and leaves. Chandramukhi  dives behind the curtain hides. The next day she comes to the Chowki and starts behaving strangely. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Inspector Chautala Hypnotized
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Chandramukhi  keeps on behaving strangely and everyone tries to get her out of her hypnosis, but nothing happens. Commissioner decides to suspend her and prints the news in newspaper. Bachha sees it and is very happy. What will Chandramukhi  do now?

episodesList.title: Film Ka Chakkar
episodesList.summary: As soon as Chandramukhi 's suspension news comes out, BaChandramukhi ha's boss comes out of hiding. Chandramukhi  reveals herself and arrests all of them. The case is solved. But soon, the Commissioner informs Chandramukhi  that IG is coming to town and he wants to see her Chowki running perfectly. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Gopi Tells Billu to Befriend Hasina
episodesList.summary: In the evening, IG sees Chandramukhi  fighting off some thugs. In the Chowki, Chandramukhi  tells him that it was twin sister who was fighting. The IG decides to meet both of them later in the evening. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Billu Comes to Meet Hasina
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi , as her twin, insults the IG. Bajrang decides to impress the twin sister to make his way for Chandramukhi . Billu is trying to impress IG's daughter. Chandramukhi  apologizes for her sister's behaviour to IG but he wants the twin sister's apology. What will Chandramukhi  do now?

episodesList.title: Ig Wants to See Surajmukhi and Chautala Together
episodesList.summary: The IG's daughter gets kidnapped. IG ask Chandramukhi  to look into it. Chandramukhi  tells him that his twin sister can help him and he says she can. Chandramukhi  goes to kidnapper and frees the daughter. Later she reveals to the IG that there are no twins. IG understands the situation and is grateful that Chandramukhi  helped him out. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Japani Bhoothni
episodesList.summary: A married couple comes to the Chowki to complain about the Japani Bhutani at there new house. Chandramukhi  speaks to the agent who sold them that house. He informs Chandramukhi  that the husband was mentally sick few years back and is again going through same symptoms. Chandramukhi  sends Gopi and Billu to their house to spend the night. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Cheater Peter Visits Inspector Chautala
episodesList.summary: After listening to Gopi's story of the other night, Chandramukhi  talks to the agent again. He informs Chandramukhi  that there is some problem with the house about which only the owner knows who resides in Japan. Chandramukhi  speaks to him over the phone and the owner tells that there is a Japani Bhutani in the house who is his dead girlfriend. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Chautala The Bhoothni
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi  asks Gopi and Billu to leave and is alone next morning. She is attacked by the Bhutani and Chandramukhi  also turns into one. Later Bajrang and Billu also turn into Bhut as they are attacked by Chandramukhi , the Bhutani. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now!

episodesList.title: Mrs Chandramukhi Saxena
episodesList.summary: Bajrang sees Chandramukhi  on a lonely road walking in the rain all alone. He asks her where she is going but she rudely talks to him. He does not understand her behaviour but gives her a lift and leaves her near the house. When she reaches the door a man come out and hugs her and call her Mrs. Chandramukhi Saxena. What will happen next? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: Binocular Spy
episodesList.summary: In this episode, the man assures Bajrang that Chandramukhi  is actually his wife, the only Mrs Saxena. Bajrang gets Gopi and Billu with him later that night to the same house. They are also shocked to see Chandramukhi  with the man. Now they are all confused and have a big question about Chandramukhi . A man with a pair of binocular is suspiciously spying the house. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Sushila
episodesList.summary: Bajrang again leaves Chandramukhi  to that house. The man greets her as Mrs Saxena and but she slaps him. He later call her Sushila. Chandramukhi  thinks there is something fishy going on and doesn't correct him that she is actually Chandramukhi  and not his wife Sushila. What will Chandramukhi  do now?

episodesList.title: Ravi The Poet
episodesList.summary: Ravi the poet comes to the Chowko and tells Chandramukhi  that his publisher betrayed him. He took the money for publishing his book and didn't publish it. Later when publisher is questioned he denies everything. Chandramukhi  as a poet meets him and makes him meets his family who portray themselves as very wealthy people. Will Chandramukhi  be able to help the poet?

episodesList.title: Pareshan
episodesList.summary: A man named Pareshan come to the Chowki with a complaint. He informs Chandramukhi  that his wife has been missing for 2 days. Chandramukhi  calls the wife's parents and they tell Chandramukhi  all the possible places she can be. Will Chandramukhi  be able to help Pareshan?

episodesList.title: Strange Ex-servant
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to the Chowki with a complaint that there ex-servant Lalit, stands in front of their house and keeps staring inside. Lalit is given a warning by Chandramukhi  and is released. But the very next day the man beats Lalit for standing in front of his house. What will Chandramukhi  do now?

episodesList.title: Oblivious Couple
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to the Chowki with a complaint that some other couple is staying in a house which they have bought recently and that the couple is completely oblivious of their presence. Gopi and Billu witness that couple and tell Chandramukhi  about them. Chandramukhi  and Bajrang go to that place as new owners. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Video Evidence
episodesList.summary: A girl files a complaint against Gopi for flirting with her and also produces a video as evidence. Chandramukhi  puts him jail. Later, two boys come and complain against Billu for breaking their car's wing mirror and also produces a video in name of proof. He is also put in jail. Soon, a girl complain against Bajrang and produces a video in name of proof. What is happening here? Will Chandramukhi  be able to help her team?

episodesList.title: Cook Crisis
episodesList.summary: A wealthy man files a complaint against his wife and mother-in-law, claiming that they don't keep any cook at his house for more than a month and as a result, he has to make all the food. Chandramukhi  warns them and sends Gopi as a cook to their place. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Plastic Samosa
episodesList.summary: Billu tries to feed a plastic samosa to Gopi. Gopi becomes really angry and decides not to talk to Billu ever again. Billu tries to apologize but Gopi does not agree. Soon, Gopi witnesses Billu die in front of his very eyes and becomes very emotional. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Gazal Kumar
episodesList.summary: Gazal Kumar files a complaint against two of his fans who every time disrupts his performances by appreciating him too violently. Chandramukhi  warns them off. The next day, Gazal Kumar comes and informs Chandramukhi  that he lost his job and the job is given to one of the fans. Chandramukhi  decides that she must teach them a lesson.

episodesList.title: Muh Kaala
episodesList.summary: A professor files complaint, claiming that someone blackened his face. Chandramukhi  gets dhobi to test the colour, and finds that the colour is some chemical that will not wash off. Just then, Gopi sees two girls in college laughing at professor. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Half-moustache
episodesList.summary: A man comes to the Chowki and tells Chandramukhi  that his barber cut off his half moustache and because of it he has been relieved from his fathers will. The man s fiancee is brought to the Chowki for questioning, and she explains that as the man is no longer wealthy her mother called off her engagement. Will Chandramukhi  be able to help the poor man?

episodesList.title: Gappu and Chappu
episodesList.summary: Gappu and Chappu launches a complaint against a kuli who always puts Gappu on another train and disrupts his day on purpose. The kuli denies this infornt of Chandramukhi and claims the two are lying. Will the team be able to get to the bottom of this mystery? Watch this episode to find out now!

plotHtml:
F.I.R. is an acronym for first information report, a document that the Indian police prepares for each case to be investigated.
F.I.R. is centered on a Haryanvi female police officer named Chandramukhi Chautala and her three subordinates, Head Constable Gopinath Gandothra, Constable Mulayam Singh Gulgule, and Constable Billu, who later joined the Chowki. The show depicts their lives as they try to solve every case which comes to their police station Imaan Chowki, Ravanpur.
The show also features romantic storylines between Chandramukhi Chautala and each of the police station's chief inspectors, Hanuman Prasad Pandey, Raj Aaryan and Bajrang Pandey.
tagline: F.I.R.

title: Fame Gurukul
summary:
Fame Gurukul is an Indian reality show on Sony Entertainment Television which premiered on 27 June 2005. The  program was produced by the same production house of Indian Idol. The concept of the show was to select a pair of India's best singers/performers.
It is based on the Spanish Operación Triunfo and international Star Academy format of Endemol, better known in English under the British title Fame Academy. Fame Gurukul started out with 16 contestants living in a musical performance academy (Gurukul). Every week (normally) one contestant was voted out of the show, and so on until two remained in the end.

articleSections.title: Prizes
articleSections.text: The finalists received a Rs.1 crore music contract from Sony in addition to a Maruti Alto car each.

After much waiting and various shows in between, the results were finally announced. Qazi Touqeer, the favourite was one of the winners, while Ruprekha Banerjee made up the pair with him.

articleSections.title: Celebrity Fame Gurukul
articleSections.text: After season 1 of Fame Gurukul, Sony Entertainment Television launched Celebrity Fame Gurukul based on the successful reality show called 'Comic Relief Does Fame Academy' which was a spin-off on 'Fame Academy' produced by the format owner Gestmusic, part of the Endemol Group. The proceeds of the show would go to the Make a Wish Foundation, a non-profit organization dedicated to granting the most cherished wishes of children living with life-threatening illnesses.

title: Family No.1
summary: Family No. 1 is  an Indian comedy television series which aired on Sony Entertainment Television from 1998 to 1999, starring Kanwaljeet Singh and Tanvi Azmi.
plot:
The show had two single parents, with three kids each, who end up having to share a newly rented house. Over time, both families go through a series of comic situations and a coming of age of the similarly aged children as they strike friendships and become closer.
A divorcee, Deepak Malhotra and his three kids - Rahul, Rashmi and Guddu live in a beach house which they share with another family the Potia family. The Potia family consists of divorcee Shalini Potia and her three children - Bharti, Toofaan and Dheer.
The story revolves around the two families adjusting and fighting while sharing the same home.

title: Family Front
summary:
Family Front (Urdu: فیملی فرنٹ) is a 1997 Pakistani comedy drama sitcom television series. It was broadcast by the Pakistan Television Corporation (PTV World, now PTV News). The sitcom was directed by Waseem Abbas and written by Muhammad Younis Butt.
The cast included Saba Hameed, Samina Ahmad, Waseem Abbas, Mira Hashmi, Naima Khan, Iram Hassan, Iffat Rahim, Anjum Shahzad and Naseem Vicky. This comedy show became highly popular and ran for many TV seasons. A spin-off sequel, titled Hum Sab Ajeeb Se Hain later aired on Aaj Entertainment.
The show was also aired on STAR Plus International in 1999.

title: Flop Show
summary:
Flop Show is an Indian television sitcom that first aired on DD National in 1989. The show was written and directed by satirical humorist Jaspal Bhatti, who also played himself as the main character. His wife Savita Bhatti produced the show and also acted in all the episodes as his wife. The sitcom was a satire on the socio-cultural problems faced by a common Indian at the time. Only 10 episodes of the show were produced.
The show was again telecast on DD National from 19 May 2020 during the lockdown due to coronavirus.

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text:
Flop Show has a distinctive opening sequence. It starts off with a dedication to those whom the specific episode is poking fun at. This is followed by the title song "Flop Show", which mocks the show itself as being misdirected. It features most of the main cast collectively playing musical instruments as a band. H. N. Singh appears as an eye-patch wearing, menacing looking director. The other cast members are dressed variously as a police inspector, a doctor, a peon, etc.
The show was shot completely in Chandigarh with some episodes being shot at Punjab Engineering College (Jaspal Bhatti is an alumnus of that college). The cast remained the same in every episode, although they played different characters as each episode essayed a different story.
Another distinctive aspect of the show is a joke in between the casting credits at the beginning and a satirically reworded popular Hindi film song played at the end of every episode, in the form of a Parody.

episodesList.title: Govt. Officer
episodesList.summary: A satirical take on the functioning of government offices. It parodies the misuse of government machinery, portrayed through a head of a government office (Jaspal Bhatti) deploying public officials and resources to search for his missing pet dog and according promotion to official who is successful in the endeavour.

episodesList.title: Medical Bills
episodesList.summary: A satirical take on fake medical reimbursement claims of employees. Jaspal Bhatti's friend, who is very ill, gets hospitalized in his name to get free government sponsored medical care. When he passes away, people assume Jaspal Bhatti to be dead.

episodesList.title: Property
episodesList.summary: A satirical take on the travails of honest real estate property owners. This episode highlights some of the devious schemes used by tenants for usurping residential property belonging to others.

episodesList.title: Contractor
episodesList.summary: A take on the poor quality construction of Government-built apartments, shoddy work of contractors and nexus between government engineers and contractors. It showcases the troubles of residents of housing complexes.

episodesList.title: Ph.D.
episodesList.summary: A satirical take on the harassment that professors guiding post-graduate research students submit them to. In this episode, Jaspal Bhatti plays the professor guiding a Ph.D. student. He gets all his domestic chores done through his protégé. Eventually, he agrees to pass his student's thesis with the intention of getting him married to his sister-in-law.

episodesList.title: Meeting
episodesList.summary: This episode takes on the daily routine of Government bureaucrats who spent most of their day in meaningless meetings and instead of making decisions, form committees and subcommittees, eventually leading to no result.

episodesList.title: Chief Guest
episodesList.summary: A satirical take on chief guests arriving late at public functions and thus making audiences wait. The episode illustrates the misery of a chief guest (Jaspal Bhatti) who actually arrives at a function on time.

episodesList.title: Doctor
episodesList.summary: A take on the callous working habits of doctors in Government hospitals, unionism amongst nurses and ward boys. Jaspal Bhatti plays a doctor who thinks that he lost his watch in a patient's stomach during a surgery.

episodesList.title: Line Man
episodesList.summary: A parody on the working of the Indian telephone department and its officials. It shows the delays in getting telephone connections, and the poor quality of telephone infrastructure in those days.

episodesList.title: TV Serial
episodesList.summary: Based on the lack of creative content in TV productions. It parodied an attempt to produce a television programme by individuals with money but no qualifications. Jaspal Bhatti plays the producer here.

title: Fauji
summary:
Fauji (translation: "Soldier") is an Indian Hindi-language television series following the training of an Indian Army commando regiment; It was Shah Rukh Khan's debut in television.  It aired on DD National in 1989, produced by New Film Addicts. It was directed by Raj Kumar Kapoor.
The story follows a new set of recruits as they begin their training to become commandos in the Indian Army. It is about the Indian Army Para SF training. The series shows the daily struggles of the recruits including physical training, the pranks they play on each other, and the punishments they receive from their officers.
Originally, Rakesh Sharma who played the role of Vikram Rai was supposed to be the hero of the serial. Shah Rukh Khan's character Abhimanyu Rai ( based on  Col Sanjoy Banerjee of the Bengal Sappers, Indian Army), was supposed to have been the second lead. However Lt. Col. Raj Kumar Kapoor said in an interview that the camera “loved him so much” that they had to change the script to prop up Khan as the lead.
Initially, Khan's role in the serial was to count the crows. He said, “I landed up on the sets of ‘Fauji’, because the house-owner that we were speaking to after we needed a smaller house post the demise of my father, got to know that I'd been in Mumbai to act, and he revealed that his own father-in-law was producing a TV serial.
"When I went there, Colonel Kapoor (producer-director) offered me this sweet role, where I make a mistake and the Major would ask me to go a tree and count the number of crows in it. Once I reveal there are four, he asks me to be ‘Saavdhaan’. I was embarrassed to go back and tell my mother that my role was all about counting crows.”
Vishwajeet Pradhan also made his debut with this serial.

title: Farmaan
summary:
Farmaan (also spelled Farman) is an Indian television show broadcast on DD National in 1994.  The show was directed by Lekh Tandon and based on Rafia Amin's novel Alam Panah, set in Hyderabad.
The show's stars included Kanwaljit Singh, Navin Nischol, Raja Bundela, Vineeta Malik, Kalpana Iyer, Neha Sharad and it was the debut serial of Deepika Deshpande Amin & Hyderabadi Actor Azam Parwana (As Nawab Tamkeen Yar Jung).
Faman had 14 episodes, and was re-run on DD National in June 2016, and DD Urdu in June 2014.
plot:
In a former royal family in Hyderabad, India, the elder heir, Azar Nawab (Kanwaljit Singh) was the son of Badi Sarkar (Vineeta Malik), a widow and matriarch. Navin Nischol played painter Waqar Chand, who was the younger brother of Azar's late father (Bade Nawab) but had withdrawn from his family over his career as an artist. Deepika played Aiman Shahab, who joins Badi Sarkar as a general assistant. Aiman lost her mother when she was young, and her father around her graduation. She lived with an aunt in Bangalore and joined Badi Sarkar's mansion named Farmaan, in Hyderabad, for work.
Badi Sarkar's step sister was Tasneem Pasha (Kalpana Iyer), a widow with two children: Shahana (Neha Sharad) and Basharat Nawab (Raja Bundela). They lived with Badi Sarkar and had a carefree lifestyle earlier in the show. Both Tasneem Pasha and Shahana were being taken for a ride by a dubious character, Mukhtar Nawab. Badi Sarkar disliked Mukhtar, because he had gotten her late husband addicted to gambling, as a result of which he had lost much of fortune. Waqar Chand also lived in a cottage on mansion grounds, but never entered the mansion as a result of a promise made to Bade Nawab.
The story progresses in Hyderabad as well as Dandeli (where Badi Sarkar's family had a timber factory), and shows the changes that take place as the family adapts, adjusts to its lifestyle. It also shows how Aiman finds her footing from a novice assistant to an assured person and finds love.
